title: Sprint retro
description: App Store screenshot meeting: Kestrel Labs prepares the version two beta. Turns are scheduled back to back from measured Kokoro durations. The first 14 s are silent so the recording, started once the call is live, catches every line.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Let's do the retro. What went well this sprint?

turns.speaker: hannah
turns.text: Deciding early on read only offline. It made the design work much simpler.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: And the Riverside call. Because we had a clear answer, Ruth was relaxed about offline editing coming later.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: We found the clock problem in sync late. If we'd tested on the clinic's old tablets earlier, we'd have caught it in week one.

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: Agreed. And I underestimated sync. The timestamp fix took two days, not half a day.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Is the beta on the third of November at risk?

turns.speaker: tomas
turns.text: Not now. The fix is merged, and Priya has signed it off.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Yes, but I'd like one more pass on a slow connection before we ship.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Then let's add that. Actions: Priya, borrow two old tablets from Riverside for testing. Tomás, add a slow network test to the build.

turns.speaker: hannah
turns.text: And can we keep a short list of what clinics ask us for? Offline editing and exports keep coming up.

turns.speaker: amara
turns.text: Good idea. Leo, can you own that list?
